name: use-media-session

description: Represents an image associated with the media (e.g., album art).

types.name: MediaImage
types.description: Represents an image associated with the media (e.g., album art).

properties.name: type
properties.description: The MIME type of the image (e.g., "image/png").

types.description: Metadata for the current media session.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: - Initial configuration for the media session.

properties.name: metadata
properties.description: Initial metadata to set for the session.

returnType.name: UseMediaSessionReturn

properties.name: isSupported

properties.name: setMetadata
properties.description: Function to update the media metadata.

properties.name: setPlaybackState

properties.name: setActionHandler
